messages:
Maya: Heads-up: proposing a lightweight rollout plan for the Optimize toolkit features (adaptive batching, KV prefix cache, quantization recommendations, eval-triggered alerting). Want to capture launch gates, telemetry contract, and what we can ship for an MVP canary.
Jordan: Nice. Can we separate telemetry contract (what metrics/events we require) from the acceptance gates? Ops needs concrete metrics to wire alerts.
Priya: For product side: customers want predictable savings and no silent regressions. Proposal: two gate sets: safety gates (must-pass) and benefit gates (goal). Safety gates block rollout.
Sanjay: Runtime constraints: prefer enabling batching+cache on Dedicated first, but we can simulate on Hosted with traffic shaping. Need API for per-tenant safe-mode and per-route toggles.
Lee: Ops requirements (telemetry contract):
- emitted events: batch_start, batch_end, cache_hit, cache_miss, quant_variant_served, eval_alert
- metrics: p50/p95 latency per-route, token_cost_per_op, eval_concordance_pct, customer_error_rate
- tag dimensions: customer_id, route, model_variant, quant_level
If any of these missing, we fail the gate.
Jordan: Acceptance gates (MVP canary):
1) Safety (hard block):
- eval_concordance_pct drop <= 2% absolute on safety suite
- customer_error_rate delta <= 0.3% over baseline
- no >P1 incidents related to caching/batching in canary window
2) Benefit (soft goal):
- token_cost_per_op improvement >= 12% for batched workloads
- median latency unchanged or improved for low-latency routes
We promote if safety passes and at least one benefit goal hits.
Priya: Customer tranche idea: pick 5 customers across tiers (enterprise, mid-market, startup). Ask legal for opt-in checklist and a two-week consent window.
Sanjay: Config sketch to include in default canary bundle:
```
optimize_toolkit:
  batching:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_ms: 10
    max_batch_size: 64
  cache:
    enabled: true
    kv_prefix_ttl_s: 300
    allow_stale_reads: false
  quant_recs:
    suggest_only: true
    target_levels: ["int8","int8-fp16-hybrid"]
  eval_alerts:
    enabled: true
    severity_map:
      discordant: P2
      regression_medium: P3
```
Lee: Also need: automatic rollback hooks if eval_alerts P2 fires or customer_error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 2 minutes. Ops will implement runbook entries.
Maya: How do we run eval-triggered alerts? Frequency and ownership?
Jordan: Eval cadence: nightly diff runs comparing candidate vs baseline on the canonical prompt set. If a prompt fails N-of-M checks or concordance delta exceeds threshold, create an alert with example diffs and attach to the canary channel.
Priya: Ownership: Alex from RE/QA owns the eval job and triage for the first month. Product will maintain the canonical prompt set and add customer-specific probes.
Sanjay: One more runtime note: quant suggestions should be advisory in canary (no forced quant serving). For Dedicated customers who opt-in, we can run A/B: 50% baseline, 50% int8 for non-critical routes.
deploy-bot: Canary slot created: canary-2987 (start: 2026-09-01T14:00Z).
Lee: Dashboard list for pilot: per-route latency, batch_size distribution, cache hit ratio, token_cost_per_op, eval_concordance_pct, active_canaries. Jordan: can you sketch widgets?
Jordan: Yep, will draft widget list and threshold annotations. Also add per-customer explainer view for pilot customers to see cost/quality tradeoffs.
Maya: Next steps: Priya to coordinate customer outreach and consent doc, Alex (QA) to own nightly evals, Sanjay to ship per-tenant safe-mode + config, Lee to implement rollback/circuit and runbook, Jordan to wire dashboards. We'll reconvene next Tue after discovery.
Priya: Agreed. Short backlog items to add to the pilot doc: consent template, canonical prompts v1, safe-mode API spec, dashboard wireframes, eval job config.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll update the pilot doc with owners and deadlines. :white_check_mark:
